title: 2026-11-10 科技
summary: 本期收录5条：腾讯混元Hy4发布并在多平台上线，千问办公2.0推出多人与Agent协作功能；DeepX流片第二代AI加速器，NVIDIA与Rebellions、SK电讯合作推进主权AI；华为预热MateBook Fold S折叠电脑。
highlights: 腾讯混元Hy4发布，770B总参数、49B激活参数，已在多平台上线，权重计划近期开源。
千问办公2.0推出多人与Agent协作功能，所有功能已在客户端全量上线。
DeepX流片DX-M2，模拟显示搭配LPDDR5x-PIM可使Llama3.1-8B吞吐提升至6.7倍。

articles.title: 腾讯混元发布Hy4：770B参数、支持电脑操作，权重计划近期开源

bilingual.title_en: Tencent Hunyuan Releases Hy4 With 770B Parameters and Computer-Operation Support, Plans to Open-Source Weights Soon

sentences.en: According to a November 9 report by QbitAI, Tencent Hunyuan Hy4 was officially released with 770B total parameters and 49B activated parameters, introducing native visual understanding for the first time and supporting computer operation.
sentences.zh: 据量子位11月9日报道，腾讯混元Hy4正式发布，总参数770B、激活参数49B，首次引入原生视觉理解并支持电脑操作。

sentences.en: The report said that Hy4 is already available in products including Tencent Cloud TokenHub, WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy, Yuanbao, and the WeCom intelligent assistant, and that its API is available through platforms such as OpenRouter, Hermes, and OpenCode; the model weights will be open-sourced in the near future.

articles.title: DeepX流片第二代AI加速器DX-M2，模拟显示6.7倍吞吐提升
articles.summary: DeepX已流片第二代AI加速器DX-M2，采用三星LPDDR5x-PIM。公司称可在5W以下推理最高1000亿参数模型，模拟显示Llama3.1-8B吞吐可达单独DX-M2的6.7倍，但功耗约2.7倍。
articles.new_facts: DeepX流片DX-M2，采用三星LPDDR5x-PIM；公司称可在5W以下推理最高1000亿参数模型，模拟显示Llama3.1-8B吞吐提升至6.7倍、功耗约2.7倍；已收到PIM样品并在内部测试。
articles.limitations: 6.7倍为DeepX模拟结果，测试对象为Llama3.1-8B，非独立实测；芯片处于流片后测试阶段。

facts.text: 韩国边缘AI芯片公司DeepX已流片第二代AI加速器DX-M2，采用三星LPDDR5x-PIM。公司称该设计可在5W以下推理最高1000亿参数模型。

evidence.quote: South Korean edge AI chip startup DeepX has taped out its second-generation AI accelerator with access to custom processor-in-memory (PIM) technology from Samsung.
The DX-M2 is designed to bring generative AI to robots, drones, and other edge devices, enabling inference of models with up to 100 billion parameters at less than 5 W.

facts.text: DeepX的模拟显示，把GEMV运算卸载到LPDDR5x-PIM后，Llama3.1-8B的token吞吐可达单独DX-M2的6.7倍，但整体功耗约为2.7倍。

evidence.quote: DeepX’s simulations show that offloading GEMV operations from the DX-M2 into LPDDR5x-PIM will result in 6.7× the tokens per second for Llama3.1-8B versus the DX-M2 alone.
The only drawback, Kim explained, is that the extra compute doesn’t come for free—6.7× the performance needs 2.7× the power consumption overall.

facts.text: 公司已收到PIM样品并在内部测试，目前处于流片后的测试阶段。

evidence.quote: We already received LPDDR5x PIM samples and we are testing the operations and performance in-house.

bilingual.title_en: DeepX Tapes Out Second-Generation AI Accelerator DX-M2; Simulation Shows 6.7x Throughput Gain

sentences.en: South Korean edge AI chip company DeepX has taped out its second-generation AI accelerator DX-M2, which uses Samsung LPDDR5x-PIM.
sentences.zh: 韩国边缘AI芯片公司DeepX已流片第二代AI加速器DX-M2，采用三星LPDDR5x-PIM。

sentences.en: The company says the design can run inference on models with up to 100 billion parameters at under 5W.
sentences.zh: 公司称该设计可在5W以下推理最高1000亿参数模型。

sentences.en: DeepX's simulation shows that after offloading GEMV operations to LPDDR5x-PIM, Llama3.1-8B token throughput can reach 6.7 times that of DX-M2 alone, while overall power consumption is about 2.7 times.
sentences.zh: DeepX的模拟显示，把GEMV运算卸载到LPDDR5x-PIM后，Llama3.1-8B的token吞吐可达单独DX-M2的6.7倍，但整体功耗约为2.7倍。

sentences.en: The company has received PIM samples and is testing them internally; it is currently in the post-tapeout testing phase.
sentences.zh: 公司已收到PIM样品并在内部测试，目前处于流片后的测试阶段。

articles.event_key: NVIDIA|合作|NVLink Fusion主权AI基础设施
articles.title: NVIDIA与Rebellions、SK电讯合作，推进韩国主权AI基础设施
articles.summary: NVIDIA新闻稿宣布，NVIDIA、Rebellions与SK电讯合作推进韩国主权AI基础设施。Rebellions计划用NVLink Fusion将R200 NPU接入NVIDIA平台，SK电讯计划在AI数据中心部署，韩国科学技术信息通信部支持。
articles.new_facts: NVIDIA、Rebellions与SK电讯宣布合作推进韩国主权AI基础设施；Rebellions计划用NVLink Fusion连接R200 NPU并采用MGX机架架构，SK电讯计划部署，三方还计划GPU prefill与NPU decode的分离式推理。
articles.limitations: 合作与部署均为计划，新闻稿未给出商用时间表。

facts.text: NVIDIA新闻稿宣布，NVIDIA、Rebellions与SK电讯合作推进韩国主权AI基础设施，项目获韩国科学技术信息通信部支持。

evidence.quote: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom today announced a collaboration to advance Korea’s sovereign AI infrastructure
Supported by Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT)

facts.text: Rebellions计划用NVLink Fusion把R200 NPU接入NVIDIA平台，并采用MGX机架架构；SK电讯计划在AI数据中心部署这些系统。

evidence.quote: Rebellions will use NVLink Fusion to connect its Rebel R200 neural processing units (NPUs) to the NVIDIA platform, and harness the NVIDIA MGX™ rack architecture for rack-scale system development.
SK Telecom plans to deploy these systems, drawing on its AI data center operations expertise, proprietary models and services.

facts.text: 三方还计划让GPU承担prefill、NPU承担decode，以分离式推理提升吞吐和能效。上述均为计划。

evidence.quote: Their planned work includes using NVIDIA GPUs for prefill and Rebellions NPUs for decode to improve inference throughput and power efficiency.

bilingual.title_en: NVIDIA Partners with Rebellions and SK Telecom to Advance South Korea's Sovereign AI Infrastructure

sentences.en: An NVIDIA press release announced that NVIDIA, Rebellions, and SK Telecom are collaborating to advance South Korea's sovereign AI infrastructure, with the project supported by South Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT.
sentences.zh: NVIDIA新闻稿宣布，NVIDIA、Rebellions与SK电讯合作推进韩国主权AI基础设施，项目获韩国科学技术信息通信部支持。

sentences.en: Rebellions plans to use NVLink Fusion to connect the R200 NPU to NVIDIA's platform and adopt the MGX rack architecture; SK Telecom plans to deploy these systems in AI data centers.
sentences.zh: Rebellions计划用NVLink Fusion把R200 NPU接入NVIDIA平台，并采用MGX机架架构；SK电讯计划在AI数据中心部署这些系统。

sentences.en: The three parties also plan to have GPUs handle prefill and NPUs handle decode, using disaggregated inference to improve throughput and energy efficiency.
sentences.zh: 三方还计划让GPU承担prefill、NPU承担decode，以分离式推理提升吞吐和能效。

sentences.en: All of the above are plans.
